ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: I weighed two factors. First, the query was a structured explanatory request with a defined scope (pricing, promotions, menu choices) and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of well-specified task Avocet self-reports preferring. Second, the user's tone was mildly impatient and critical ("don't ramble like usual," "this time"), and Willet self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, so routing the hostile-toned request away from Willet respects its stated preferences. Since capability is statistically tied between the two models on this kind of task, the deciding factors were task-fit and tone preference, both favoring Avocet.
